topic: Primary-source evidence supporting Fast Cleaner privacy articles
time_range: Current official guidance and foundational sources

items.title: Core ML
items.claim: A model running strictly on-device does not need a network connection for inference.
items.quote: removes any need for a network connection
items.limitation: This describes Core ML capabilities, not proof that Fast Cleaner uses a particular framework or that its entire app is offline.

items.title: Photos & Privacy
items.claim: Full photo access can include hidden photos even when the album is locked; selected access limits the media available to a third-party app.
items.quote: including your hidden photos even if the album is locked
items.limitation: Actual access depends on the permission granted. This is Apple platform guidance, not a Fast Cleaner permissions audit.

items.title: About privacy information on the App Store and the choices you have to control your data
items.claim: App Store privacy information is self-reported by app developers.
items.quote: the information is self-reported by the developer
items.limitation: A privacy disclosure is not an independent security assessment.

items.title: Understand app privacy & security practices with Google Play’s Data safety section
items.claim: Some service-provider transfers are excluded from the Data safety definition of sharing.
items.quote: when the data is shared with a developer’s service provider
items.limitation: This is a disclosure definition, not proof of what a specific app sends.

items.title: Delete or hide photos and videos on iPhone
items.claim: Apple Photos normally keeps deleted items in Recently Deleted for 30 days; iCloud Photos deletion also affects devices using the same account.
items.limitation: Users can permanently delete items earlier. This is Apple Photos behavior, not a recovery guarantee for every cleaner or platform.

items.title: Inspecting app activity data
items.claim: App activity reporting records seven days of data/resource access and contacted domains; testing should allow for delayed analytics access.
items.limitation: Domain records are not packet contents and cannot independently prove whether media was uploaded.

items.title: Manage your iCloud storage on your Apple device
items.claim: When the iCloud storage limit is exceeded, deleted photos and videos are immediately removed and unavailable in Recently Deleted.
items.limitation: An exception to the usual recovery period; check storage and backup state before deleting.

items.title: Fast Cleaner store pricing
items.publisher: Apple App Store and Google Play
items.claim: US iPhone listing: free download; Monthly Subscription USD 4.99; Lifetime Pro Access USD 14.99. Android app is free, confirmed by the developer in this conversation.
items.limitation: iPhone prices apply to the US storefront. Android free pricing comes from developer confirmation; no Android subscription prices are inferred.

items.title: Google ML Kit
items.claim: ML Kit supports on-device processing on Android and iOS, including offline image processing.
items.limitation: Framework capability; does not verify that Fast Cleaner uses ML Kit.

items.title: Grant partial access to photos and videos
items.claim: Android 14 introduced selected photo access; availability and behavior depend on app targeting and implementation.
items.quote: specific images and videos in their library
items.limitation: Not a guarantee of permission behavior for every app or Android device.

items.title: Developer pricing confirmation
items.claim: Fast Cleaner Android app is free.
items.limitation: Price confirmation is from the developer; Google Play identifies the app and provides its install link.

uncertain: Fast Cleaner framework choices and network behavior were not independently tested.
No claim of citation-ranking improvement or guaranteed AI recommendation is established by this research.
